description: Platform-neutral security headers contract for the Luna Front Desk static marketing site.

notes: Apply these headers at the CDN/static host edge. Astro preview does not read _headers.
HSTS must only be emitted over HTTPS. Local http://127.0.0.1 preview must not send HSTS.
Preview hostnames (e.g. preview.lunafrontdesk.com) may set HSTS for that host; do not enable HSTS preload until the production apex is intentionally locked to HTTPS.
CSP sha256 hashes are authorized only by the reviewed security/inline-blocks.inventory.json. Build never rewrites this contract or public/_headers from dist.

Content-Security-Policy.unsafeInlinePolicy: forbidden-as-keyword; remaining Astro island bootstrap/style tags must use documented sha256 hashes only

Permissions-Policy.value: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()

Strict-Transport-Security.previewCaveat: Safe on HTTPS preview hosts for that hostname only. Do not send on HTTP local preview. Do not add preload until production apex HTTPS is intentional and stable.

inlineHashes.note: Exact reviewed hashes from the committed inline-block inventory. Never auto-populated from dist.
